description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of S. L. - Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting - w.e.f. 01.01.2020
reasoning: This gazette content involves the adoption and publication of amendments to the Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements for financial reporting standards, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories.
